semantic_fixes: Spark date_trunc('week') is Monday-based, so it maps to DATE_TRUNC(txn_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) instead of the Sunday-based default WEEK

Window + row_number()==1 for the latest forecast version maps to QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(sku)) ...) = 1, with the week_start <= run_date filter applied after the dedup as in the notebook
Spark (ANSI off) returns NULL on x/0, so ape, bias_pct and accuracy_pct use SAFE_DIVIDE
F.round(x, 2) maps to CAST(ROUND(CAST(x AS NUMERIC), 2) AS FLOAT64)
units.summary: Resumed migrate/forecastaccuracy and merged origin/main into it. Main now has the _load_ts staging fix in tools/parity.py and the postgres provider. With those in place, make parity UNIT=forecastaccuracy exits 0: gold_forecast_accuracy has 790 legacy rows and 790 BigQuery rows, 8/8 columns match, and checksums are identical. No SQL change was needed. make lint is clean. MIGRATION_NOTES.md now has the passing parity table, and the parity report is committed. PR #9 is updated with the activity mapping and parity table. The results come from the BigQuery emulator only.

semantic_fixes: normalize_sku -> UPPER(TRIM(sku)); ~is_return -> NOT is_return
Trailing 28-day range left join rewritten as a running SUM over sales UNION ALL start/end marker rows (the emulator times out on the join and rejects RANGE n PRECEDING with PARTITION BY)
Duplicate snapshot rows: the notebook groups after the join, so each duplicate's sales count again; reproduced with dup_rows * units
F.round -> CAST(ROUND(CAST(x AS NUMERIC), n) AS FLOAT64); division via SAFE_DIVIDE
lag computed on grouped snapshot rows before the running-sum window (the emulator rejects a second analytic function after it)

Spark lag over non-unique orderBy(snapshot_date): legacy tie order is a shuffle/hash-aggregate artefact (replay shows 0/93/102/12 diffs for shuffle.partitions 4/8/1 and AQE off). SQL uses on_hand_units as a deterministic tiebreak, which leaves 154 wow_change_units mismatches
shared_change_requests: Business decision + legacy/ change: dedupe udl.inventory_snapshots per (snapshot_date, store_id, sku), or add an agreed tiebreak (e.g. on_hand_units) to nb_inventory_cover's lag window, then regenerate migration/baseline/pds_rsi.gold_inventory_health.json.gz. Without this, exact parity on wow_change_units is impossible.
Master DAG (integrator): order salesdaily >> inventoryhealth (race_condition finding)
units.summary: Merged origin/main (with the _load_ts harness fix) and reran make parity. All 4,248 rows and every column match except wow_change_units: 154 rows, all in the 8 store/sku pairs with duplicate snapshots per date. An out-of-repo replay on PySpark matched the baseline exactly, and changing only the Spark shuffle/AQE config changes those legacy values. The legacy tie order therefore comes from Spark's physical execution, not from business logic. Not passed: this needs a dedupe or tiebreak decision plus a baseline change. Lint is clean. Notes and the report were pushed and PR #13 was updated.

not_replayed: DEFAULT_ARGS.on_failure_callback (failure alert convention; no activity in pipeline JSON)
semantic_fixes: %sql temp view v_sales_enriched -> CTE; CAST(date_trunc('month', txn_date) AS DATE) -> DATE_TRUNC(txn_date, MONTH)
SCD2 dim_store join keeps s.is_current filter
F.round (brand revenue 2dp, category revenue 2dp, value share 3dp) -> CAST(ROUND(CAST(x AS NUMERIC), n) AS FLOAT64); category revenue is rounded sum of rounded brand revenues as in notebook
100 * brand / category -> SAFE_DIVIDE (Spark returns NULL on x/0 with ANSI off)
F.dense_rank().over(window orderBy desc) -> DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month, country, retailer, category ORDER BY brand_revenue_eur DESC), INT64
ZetaSQL/emulator: CTE named 'category' made PARTITION BY category resolve to the row struct; renamed CTE to brand_category

semantic_fixes: date_trunc('week') (Monday-based) -> DATE_TRUNC(txn_date, WEEK(MONDAY))
~is_return -> WHERE NOT is_return
normalize_sku -> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) on udl.promotions
left_semi date-overlap promo join -> SELECT DISTINCT inner join + LEFT JOIN, on_promo = matched (COALESCE false)
lag / avg rowsBetween(-3,0) -> LAG / AVG ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
x/0 NULL in Spark -> SAFE_DIVIDE
log(x<=0) NULL in Spark -> IF(x > 0, LN(x), NULL); log1p(u) -> LN(1 + u)
Spark round(double) HALF_UP on decimal string: NUMERIC-cast pattern wrong under float drift (37.9449/6) -> exact Jinja macro spark_round(x, n) comparing |x| against the tie (10k+5)/10^(n+1)
Emulator: no unary minus (0 - x) and SIGN(x)*y/n truncates -> IF(x < 0, 0 - m, m)
